info.name: Mayapada eProc Stress
info.description:
These endpoints perform real Odoo ORM transactions. Use only against a disposable/local/test database unless explicitly approved.

Run requests manually in workflow order. Login and Health are runtime validated. Task 904 Create PR is runtime validated on mayapada-local. All other transaction routes are not yet runtime validated. No collection script stores passwords or session cookies; Postman's cookie jar manages the Odoo session.

request.description: RUNTIME VALIDATED. Native Odoo web session controller (`web.session`), not `/api/auth`. Authenticates the selected `{{db}}` with `{{login}}` and `{{password}}`. Prerequisite: a valid local test account and the Mayapada-Local environment. Side effect: establishes an Odoo session in Postman's cookie jar; it creates no eProc document. Set the password locally in Postman and never export it. The response is JSON-RPC; the server sets `session_id` as an HTTP-only cookie. No script saves the cookie to a variable.

RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `EprocStressController.health` and checks the dedicated eProc stress service. Prerequisite: run Login first with the same base URL so Postman sends its session cookie. Side effect: none; this is a read-only HTTP check.

RUNTIME VALIDATED on `mayapada-local` only. Calls `eproc.request.create` with one `eproc.request.line` through the stress controller. The IDs in this request were verified for company 1, department 17675, product 1302744, pack 2, procurement type 1 (`T904` prefix), and approval type 2. Prerequisite: authenticated user with access to company 1 and the required eProc models. Side effect: creates a **new draft PR every time it is sent** and stores its returned ID in `{{pr_id}}`. Send manually once per intended test; the previously created PR ID is not embedded here.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201 && body.success === true && body.data.id) { pm.environment.set("pr_id", body.data.id); }

request.description: NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.request.action_confirm` on `{{pr_id}}`. Prerequisite: an existing draft or rejected PR whose company, user, department, product mapping, pack, quantity, and approval configuration pass model validation. Side effects: can create or restart approval logs, change PR state, synchronize suggestions, and notify approvers. A returned action can be pending; this request does not complete it. The resulting state depends on approval rules and is deliberately not asserted.

NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.request.action_approve` on `{{pr_id}}`. Prerequisite: PR in approval state with a pending approval log; use an appropriately authorized Odoo user. Side effects: records an approval, can notify the next approver, and may eventually move the PR to ready. One call need not finish the approval workflow. No final state is asserted.

NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.order.create` with `eproc.order.line` records. Prerequisite: authenticate, then replace every blank numeric placeholder with verified IDs and price for the chosen company, supplier, product, pack, and approval configuration. Side effect: creates a new RFQ; on HTTP 201 its ID is stored in `{{rfq_id}}`. No placeholder here is claimed to be a valid local database ID.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201 && body.success === true && body.data.id) { pm.environment.set("rfq_id", body.data.id); }

request.description:
NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Creates `eproc.request.realize.wizard`, selects existing PR lines, and runs `action_validate`. Prerequisite: eligible PR line IDs and matching company/type/approval configuration. The saved request body is **direct realization**, which requires a valid `agreement_id`. For **tender realization**, replace the body with this alternative; it requires `supplier_ids` instead of `agreement_id`:

```json
{
  "company_id": {{rfq_company_id}},
  "purchase_type_id": {{rfq_purchase_type_id}},
  "approval_type_id": {{rfq_approval_type_id}},
  "realize_method": "tender",
  "supplier_ids": [{{supplier_id}}],
  "line_ids": [
    {"request_line_id": {{request_line_id}}, "pack_order": 1}
  ]
}
```

All IDs are placeholders requiring read-only verification. Side effects: creates wizard records and one or more RFQs through existing workflow logic. On success, the first returned RFQ ID is stored in `{{rfq_id}}`; inspect the `rfqs` array if more than one is created.

exec: pm.test("at least one RFQ returned", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.rfqs).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; });
if (pm.response.code === 201 && body.success === true && body.data.rfqs && body.data.rfqs[0] && body.data.rfqs[0].id) { pm.environment.set("rfq_id", body.data.rfqs[0].id); }

request.description: NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.order.action_confirm`. Prerequisite: an existing RFQ in draft, tender, or rejected state, valid supplier/agreement/product configuration, and an authorized user. Side effects: may open a quantity-multiple confirmation wizard, change state, create approval logs, and notify approvers. The response may contain `pending_action`; no resulting state is assumed.

NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.order.action_approve`. Prerequisite: RFQ in approval state with a pending approval queue and an authorized approver. Side effects: records approval, may change RFQ/PO state and trigger downstream workflow. One call need not finish all approval steps.

NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.agreement.create` with rate-agreement lines. Only `type: rate` is supported by this endpoint; tender/tabulation creation is **not** covered. Prerequisite: verify company, procurement type, supplier, approval type, product, pack, price, and date range; set all placeholder variables before sending. Side effect: creates a draft rate agreement and saves its returned ID in `{{agreement_id}}` on HTTP 201.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201 && body.success === true && body.data.id) { pm.environment.set("agreement_id", body.data.id); }

request.description: NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.agreement.action_confirm`. Prerequisite: a draft rate agreement with valid dates, lines, supplier, and non-overlapping configuration. Side effects: starts the agreement approval workflow and may change its state; the exact resulting state is not asserted.

NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.agreement.action_approve`. Prerequisite: an agreement in approval state and an authorized approver. Side effects: records approval and may validate the agreement; one call need not complete every approval step.

NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls the existing `eproc.orderpoint.log._generate_orderpoint_logs` suggestion-generation business logic for company 1. Prerequisite: authenticated user with access to company 1 and relevant orderpoints. Side effect: can create draft orderpoint suggestion logs; it does not directly create a PR. Company ID 1 was verified locally for task 904, but this workflow has not been tested.

NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Creates `eproc.orderpoint.realize.wizard` from selected draft `eproc.orderpoint.log` IDs and calls `action_confirm_realize`. Prerequisite: verify company, purchase type, approval type, and eligible log IDs; populate the placeholders. Side effects: may create a **draft PR** and link logs, or return HTTP 202 with a confirmation action instead. Review the action before any further step. No placeholder ID has been runtime validated.

exec: pm.test("request or pending action returned", function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(Boolean(data.request || data.pending_action)).to.eql(true); });

request.description:
NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.receipt.create` with receipt lines. The request body shown is the **PO** example; the two separate alternatives below are **WO** and **RT**. Replace every placeholder with verified compatible records before sending. PO/RT single receipts require an order and order line; WO requires the listed product, pack, price, conversion, and UoM fields. Side effect: creates a receipt and stores `{{receipt_id}}` on HTTP 201. **Receiving validation can cause stock, accounting, and interfacing side effects.**

**WO body (replace the request body to use):**

```json
{
  "receipt_type": "WO",
  "company_id": {{receipt_company_id}},
  "approval_type_id": {{receipt_approval_type_id}},
  "supplier_id": {{supplier_id}},
  "line_ids": [
    {
      "product_tmpl_id": {{product_tmpl_id}},
      "name": "Verified product description",
      "pack_id": {{pack_id}},
      "pack_receipt": 1,
      "pack_price": {{receipt_pack_price}},
      "pack_rate": {{receipt_pack_rate}},
      "uom_id": {{uom_id}}
    }
  ]
}
```

**RT body (replace the request body to use):**

```json
{
  "receipt_type": "RT",
  "receipt_method": "single",
  "company_id": {{receipt_company_id}},
  "purchase_type_id": {{receipt_purchase_type_id}},
  "supplier_id": {{supplier_id}},
  "order_id": {{order_id}},
  "line_ids": [
    {"order_line_id": {{order_line_id}}, "pack_receipt": 1}
  ]
}
```

These examples are controller-shaped templates, not runtime-validated data.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201 && body.success === true && body.data.id) { pm.environment.set("receipt_id", body.data.id); }

request.description: NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.receipt.action_confirm_srb`. Prerequisite: a **draft** Receiving Bay record with valid lines. Side effects: validates lines, moves it to confirmed state, and posts a message. **Later receiving validation can cause stock, accounting, and interfacing side effects.**

NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.receipt.action_confirm_srv`. Prerequisite: PO receipt in **confirmed** Receiving Bay state, or eligible WO receipt in draft/confirmed/rejected state with an approval matrix. RT records use Confirm Return instead. Side effects: may complete receiving immediately or start approval, with possible **stock, accounting, and interfacing effects**. Do not assume one call reaches a final state.

NOT YET RUNTIME VALIDATED. Calls `eproc.receipt.action_confirm_return`. Prerequisite: a **draft RT** (vendor return) receipt with valid lines. Side effects: completes the return and may produce **stock, accounting, and interfacing effects**.
